memories.label: release:v0.1.0
memories.content: v0.1.0 release notes. Initial public release of mnemo, the encrypted single-file agent memory engine. Includes the four memory types, multi-signal recall, Python bindings, CLI binary with init/info/import/index/search/verify/rekey/compact/snapshots/restore/demo subcommands.

memories.label: release:v0.2.0
memories.content: v0.2.0 release notes. Added track_access on Memory for recency/frequency recall signals. Python package renamed to mnemo. Catalog cap at 1M memories to keep manifest decode bounded.

memories.label: release:v0.3.0
memories.content: v0.3.0 release notes. File locking (mandatory on Windows, advisory elsewhere) and read-only opens. One writer at a time, many readers concurrently. Mnemo::open_read_only is the new API.

memories.label: release:v0.3.1
memories.content: v0.3.1 release notes. Interactive passphrase prompts in the CLI; query-file input on recall; manifest cap and security-model notes.

memories.label: release:v0.3.2
memories.content: v0.3.2 release notes. Documentation pass only — no engine changes. Clarified the security model, passphrase handling and backup story.

memories.label: release:v0.4.0
memories.content: v0.4.0 release notes. Format v8 bump: catalog-side access stats + result cache. MCP server (mnemo serve --mcp) with the first set of JSON-RPC tools. Phase 10.1 / 10.3 / 10.4 shipped.

memories.label: release:v0.4.1
memories.content: v0.4.1 release notes. Python binding parity — set_cache_flush_policy, set_cache_budget, rekey, compact_file, memories, dimensions all exposed. PyPI Trusted Publishing wired up in the release workflow.

memories.label: release:v0.5.0
memories.content: v0.5.0 release notes. Phase 3 bring-your-own-embedder complete: Embedder trait, remember_text, EmbedCmd persistent-child adapter, CLI remember/recall --text, MCP --embed-cmd. All-zero vectors are now refused (breaking signal).

memories.label: pr:PR-3
memories.content: PR 3 shipped format v8 and the exact-key result_cache module. Every mutation flushes before returning so a cache hit is as durable as a direct catalog read.

memories.label: pr:PR-4
memories.content: PR 4 added the Phase 10.2 semantic cache — vector-keyed cache with cosine similarity threshold. Model name defaults to the embedder's identity when text is used.

memories.label: pr:PR-5
memories.content: PR 5 added the Phase 10.4 live surfaces: MCP tool wiring, Python binding exposure, and a decorator on the Python Mnemo class for transparent caching.

memories.label: pr:PR-7
memories.content: PR 7 added the fuzzing scaffold: cargo-fuzz crate under mnemo/fuzz, five fuzz_targets, scheduled weekly runs, panic hardening in format/wal/pager.

memories.label: pr:PR-8
memories.content: PR 8 added the proptest state machine with a crash-injection hook under the __failpoints feature. Shipped in four follow-ups (8/8.1/8.2/8.3).

memories.label: pr:PR-9
memories.content: PR 9 added cargo-deny gates (advisories/bans/licenses/sources), a cargo fmt --check CI job, and switched maturin publishing to PyPI Trusted Publishing.

memories.label: pr:PR-BP
memories.content: PR BP (binding parity) exposed set_cache_flush_policy, set_cache_budget, rekey, compact_file, memories, dimensions on the Python Mnemo class — one method per missing Rust API.

memories.label: pr:PR-10a
memories.content: PR 10a introduced the Embedder trait and EmbedderIdentity, Mnemo::remember_text, Memory::from_text, the manifest identity check on set_embedder, and all-zero vector rejection. Phase 3 part 1.

memories.label: pr:PR-10b
memories.content: PR 10b built the EmbedCmd persistent-child adapter and wired --embed-cmd/--embed-name into CLI remember/recall and MCP serve. Phase 3 part 2.

memories.label: pr:PR-10b.2
memories.content: PR 10b.2 fixed EmbedCmd correctness. Reader thread + mpsc channel so recv_timeout actually fires; kill child on any protocol error and respawn on the next call; --embed-timeout flag.

memories.label: api:Mnemo::open
memories.content: Mnemo::open(path, passphrase) opens an existing encrypted memory file for read-write access. The file lock is exclusive; open_read_only is the shared-reader alternative.

memories.label: api:Mnemo::recall
memories.content: fn recall(req: &RecallRequest) -> Result<Vec<RecallResult>>. Multi-signal recall: top_k by α·similarity + β·recency + γ·importance + δ·ln(uses+1).

memories.label: api:Mnemo::remember
memories.content: fn remember(m: Memory) -> Result<Ulid>. Writes one memory into the store; returns its Ulid. All-zero vectors are refused since v0.5.0.

memories.label: api:Mnemo::flush
memories.content: fn flush(&mut self) -> Result<()>. One atomic fsync transaction across the WAL. Crash-recovery replays the WAL on the next open.

memories.label: api:EmbedCmd
memories.content: EmbedCmd — persistent-child Embedder adapter. Spawns the user's embedder command once per Mnemo handle, speaks line-delimited JSON, and respawns on any protocol error.

memories.label: api:Session
memories.content: Session — conversation wrapper that consolidates its turns into episodic memory on close. One agent_id per session; recall is automatically scoped to that agent.

memories.label: api:ScoreWeights
memories.content: ScoreWeights {alpha, beta, gamma, delta, half_life_secs} — the four coefficients and the half-life that combine the recall signals into a single score. Defaults tuned for conversational agents.

memories.label: api:Metric
memories.content: Metric — recall distance function. Cosine (the default, used by the result cache's semantic variant too) and Dot are supported.

memories.label: decision:ivf-vs-hnsw
memories.content: Decision: IVF+PQ (not HNSW) for the Phase 2 approximate index. IVF is linear in extra space and reconstructs cleanly from the catalog; HNSW's hierarchical links would need their own durability story.

memories.label: decision:format-v8
memories.content: Decision: format v8 moves access-stats catalog-side so flushes can be lock-free on the hot path. Readers see the same stats they'd see from a catalog scan.

memories.label: decision:all-zero-reject
memories.content: Decision: refuse all-zero embedding vectors at remember time. They score exactly 0 on every cosine query, so they can't contribute signal — but recency and importance can still pull them into top-k as noise.

memories.label: decision:phase2-moved-up
memories.content: Decision: Phase 2 (hybrid BM25+vector recall) moved up in the roadmap, right after Phase 6 and Recall scoring v2. User priority: correct answers before faster answers.

memories.label: decision:no-shell-embed-cmd
memories.content: Decision: --embed-cmd is parsed with a Rust shlex_split; no shell is invoked. No $VAR or ~ expansion. Keeps the shell-injection surface at zero.

memories.label: decision:stdout-replies-only
memories.content: Decision: an embed-cmd child's stdout is reserved for replies only. Any other line (banner, log, warning) is a protocol violation and triggers a kill-and-respawn. Log to stderr.

memories.label: decision:windows-stack
memories.content: Decision: run the CLI dispatch on an 8 MiB worker thread. Windows' default main-thread stack is 1 MiB and the ~600-line match in run() can overflow it in debug builds.

memories.label: decision:pypi-trusted
memories.content: Decision: PyPI Trusted Publishing (OIDC from GitHub Actions) instead of long-lived PyPI tokens. One fewer secret in the repo settings.

memories.label: decision:format-v9-combine
memories.content: Decision: fold the Phase 11.2 hot-field inline optimization into the same v9 format bump that Phase 2 will need, so users pay the migration cost once.

memories.label: noise:1
memories.content: Project onboarding checklist: clone the repo, install Rust 1.75+, run cargo test, then run the dogfood script test/scripts/project_memory.py --about to see every onboarding note.

memories.label: noise:2
memories.content: The MCP server reads MNEMO_PASSPHRASE from the environment; a --passphrase CLI arg would land in process listings and shell history, which is why it's not supported.

memories.label: noise:3
memories.content: Agent memory should be local-first: one encrypted file per agent, copyable and backupable without a database. That is the whole point of the single-file format.

memories.label: noise:4
memories.content: The CLI mnemo info prints file size, encrypted bool, WAL region size, created_at, agents, snapshot count, cache summary, and ANN index info.

memories.label: noise:5
memories.content: mnemo compact collapses soft-deleted memories and old snapshot pages into a fresh catalog. Call it periodically on long-lived files to recover disk space.

memories.label: noise:6
memories.content: Snapshots are point-in-time recovery markers; every flush creates one, mnemo snapshots lists them, mnemo restore <id> rolls back to one.

memories.label: noise:7
memories.content: The write-ahead log region is fixed at 64 pages (512 KiB) today. At small N it dominates file size — the baseline perf file reported 62% WAL share on a 28-memory dogfood file.

memories.label: noise:8
memories.content: KDF defaults to Argon2id with memory=96MB and iterations=3 at open time. Faster for tests, production KDF for real files; configurable via KdfParams::fast / ::secure.

memories.label: noise:9
memories.content: The Phase 1.3 proptest state machine runs on every PR and under MSRV. Crash injection is behind the __failpoints feature so the non-test build doesn't carry the hook.

memories.label: noise:10
memories.content: Python's with mnemo.open(...) context manager calls close() on scope exit. On read-only handles this now short-circuits through the mode-aware Rust close() instead of calling flush() (which would raise ReadOnly).

memories.label: noise:11
memories.content: The deny.toml policy lists allowed licenses (Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, Unicode-DFS-2016) and bans unmaintained or security-advisory-flagged crates.

memories.label: noise:12
memories.content: Node bindings via napi-rs are on the roadmap (Phase 6 of the original plan). Not shipped yet; the Rust core they'd wrap is complete.

memories.label: noise:13
memories.content: The AGENTS.md workflow calls db.about() at the start of every session, then recalls the three most relevant onboarding memories before touching code.

memories.label: noise:14
memories.content: Test corpus memories are generated by test/scripts/seed.json, a 31-entry list the dogfood file is initialized from. The first entry is the manifest.

memories.label: noise:15
memories.content: Phase 5 added the Session type. A session owns one agent_id and automatically scopes recall and remember to that agent.

memories.label: noise:16
memories.content: The result cache has a semantic variant: cache_put_semantic takes a vector or text, cache_get_semantic returns the nearest hit above a cosine threshold. Model name tracked separately.

memories.label: noise:17
memories.content: The embedder for the dogfood file is sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384 dimensions, normalized output). Recorded on the scaffold manifest.

memories.label: noise:18
memories.content: File lock contention surfaces as MnemoError::Locked. The Python binding converts it to RuntimeError('file already locked ...'); the Rust binary exits non-zero with that message on stderr.

memories.label: noise:19
memories.content: The MCP server deliberately runs recall with track_access=false so an exploratory 'what do you know about X' call doesn't bump every memory's access_count.

memories.label: noise:20
memories.content: WAL replay on open re-applies any un-fsynced pages from the last transaction. Idempotent, bounded by WAL region size, and runs before any catalog read.
